title: Third party cases.
bodyText: Notwithstanding any other law to the contrary, no person shall be liable under this chapter under civil principles of vicarious liability.
bodyHtml: [§663E-4]  Third party cases.  Notwithstanding any other law to the contrary, no person shall be liable under this chapter under civil principles of vicarious liability. [L 2004, c 44, pt of §13]
